name: University of Hertfordshire
description: The University of Hertfordshire is a public university in Hatfield, just north of London, which gained university status in 1992 after starting as Hatfield Technical College in 1952. It has a large international student body and is known for engineering, health and creative arts.
whyIncluded: The University of Hertfordshire is among the 10 universities in the United Kingdom most chosen by international students (19,310 non-UK students in 2024-25, the second most of any UK provider, HESA), per the FinexisEdu shortlist research of October 2026.

livingCosts.summary: Based on the University of Hertfordshire's own table of average monthly costs for international students, for a 9-month academic year; excludes flights and visas.
livingCosts.notes: Herts International 'Cost of living' page (fetched 2026-10-07, undated; treated as current for 2026/27). Average monthly costs: rent £500-£1,120 (housing = midpoint £810; off-campus utilities £80/month extra, included on campus, not added); food £200; travel £80-£200 (transport = midpoint £140); personal = laundry £40 + telephone £20 + entertainment £60 + TV licence £15 + miscellaneous £80 = £215. Childcare (£592) and one-off costs (laptop £1,000, warm clothing £400-£450, trips £500) excluded. The page's headline estimate is 'up to £1,600 a month' for accommodation, bills, food and other living costs; 9 months used as for UK visa maintenance outside London (undergraduate courses run 37 weeks, postgraduate 50).

programmes.name: BSc (Hons) Computer Science
programmes.summary: Yearly tuition for international students starting in 2027. Herts may raise fees for continuing students, so later years could cost more.
programmes.notes: Herts course page 'BSc (Hons) Computer Science' (fetched 2026-10-07): international full-time fee £17,970 for the 2027/2028 academic year (2026/2027: £17,450); 3-year full-time route (placement/study-abroad years not costed). Herts course pages say tuition fees are charged annually, quoted for the specified year only, and 'may be higher in future years, for both new and continuing students' (Fees and Finance Policy), so cohortLocked is false. No separate compulsory fees. Herts offers a discount (£1,000 in recent years) for paying the full fee upfront; not applied here. History: the Herts 'Tuition fees' page lists the standard international undergraduate fee for new students as £17,450 (2026/27), £15,965 (2025/26) and £15,500 (2024/25), with some courses on non-standard fees. This course is on the standard fee in 2026/27 and 2027/28, so the standard rates are used for 2025 and 2024; no course-specific earlier figure was found.
